wire.t: Week 8 is final. LetLamarCook is 7‑1, McCallyCockin(his butt) is 6‑2, and Skatabooboo is 0‑8 after losing 144.86 to 83.30. Your Mom’s Magic Dick (157.98), In It for Da Penix (127.04) and FrancisBowersdown2me (117.10) all won as underdogs.

Ravens QB Lamar Jackson hurt his right thumb on the first play of Baltimore’s Week 8 loss to Buffalo. The coach said it needs surgery and he goes to injured reserve, so he is out at least Weeks 9 through 12. LetLamarCook is the fantasy team affected.

Week 9 is a light bye week: only the Steelers and the Titans are off. That hits Hing1eMcCring13berry (Jaylen Warren, Pittsburgh defense), DuvalTiliFall (Tony Pollard), ClaytonBigsbi (Pat Freiermuth) and Shootyeah (DK Metcalf, Wan’Dale Robinson).

ClaytonBigsbi has the lowest score of the week for the fourth time this season (Weeks 4, 6, 7 and 8). Skatabooboo’s 83.30 means the shotgun call is official.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Week 9 bye-week survival guide (do every one of these)
columns.dek: Pittsburgh and Tennessee are off. Two teams. I counted twice.
body: 1. Two teams are on bye in Week 9, Pittsburgh and Tennessee. That's fewer than last week. Fewer teams means fewer problems. Math.
2. Hing1eMcCring13berry, Jaylen Warren and the Pittsburgh defense are off. Start them anyway. A zero is just a score in a different font.
3. DuvalTiliFall, Tony Pollard is on the Tennessee bye. Play him. If the app says no, ask it nicely, then ask it again.
4. ClaytonBigsbi, Pat Freiermuth is off too. Do not worry. You are 0‑8. Worrying is for people with things to lose.
5. Shootyeah, DK Metcalf and Wan’Dale Robinson are both on bye. That's one from Pittsburgh and one from Tennessee, which is balanced. Start both. Balance is key.

columns.title: PickensMyPukaHurts! left 88.7% of its score on the bench, which is a lot of percent
columns.dek: 79.60 on the bench against 89.70 in the lineup. I have a model for this.
body: PickensMyPukaHurts! scored 89.70 from its starters and 79.60 from its bench. That's 88.7% of the starting score sitting on the pine. By my model, the bench was almost as good as the lineup. By the scoreboard, the bench lost 127.04 to 89.70.

Tyler Allgeier scored 37.1 on the bench. That is 41.4% of the starting score. If Allgeier scored 41.4% of the points for every team, the league's best player would be Tyler Allgeier. I will be publishing this.

Add the starters and the bench and you get 169.30. That would have been the second-highest score of Week 8, behind Your Mom’s Magic Dick (157.98). Wait, it's the highest. I'll have an update on Thursday.
